differences: The paper reports 87 children (33 in Year 2, 27 in Year 4, 27 in Year 6; 44 female); the shared file has 88 rows (28 in Year 6, 44 female and 44 male), one more male in Year 6, unexplained in the deposit. Partial correlations of VMM with writing and reading (r = -0.42 and -0.32, controlling for exact age and copying OE) could not be reproduced because exact age was removed (with school year in its place the values are -0.29 and -0.26). Writing_converted is not strictly consecutive (2a=2, 2b=3, 2c=4, 3=6, 3a=5).
